answer: In our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is ensured by a stake-slashing mechanism that leverages a novel, ivory-like, reputation-based system. Each autonomous agent maintains a pulse on its peers' behavior, updating a reputation score that influences its voting power. This creates an oasis of trust, where malicious agents are deterred by the prospect of losing their stake, thus maintaining the integrity of the network.
